skills.name: Howl
skills.description:
Sends nearby monsters
scrambling away in fear

skills.name: Find Potion
skills.description:
Use on the corpse of a slain monster
for a chance to find a potion

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Enrages nearby monsters into relentlessly attacking

skills.name: Shout
skills.description:
Warns of impending danger and improves the defense
rating of you and your party

skills.name: Find Item
skills.description:
Use on the corpse of a slain monster
to find hidden treasures

skills.name: Battle Cry
skills.description:
Fearsome cry that decreases
enemies' defense rating and physical damage resistance

skills.name: Battle Orders
skills.description:
Improves the maximum mana and life
of you and your party

skills.name: Grim Ward
skills.description:
Use on the corpse of a slain monster
to create a frightening totem
that increases damage and attack rating
for you and your party
